title: JetBlue Grabs Spirit's Slots, Emirates Ditches the A380, and First Class Gets Cheaper (And Worse)
summary: The FAA hands JetBlue the keys to LaGuardia after Spirit's collapse, and we get into why that actually makes sense. Plus, Emirates quietly pulls its flagship A380 from nine cities, Delta and United start nickel-and-diming first class passengers while American sits back and smiles, and a Delta A350 has a very bad morning at LAX.
